name: ReachInbox
description: ReachInbox is an AI-powered cold outreach platform that helps outbound teams find and verify leads, auto-personalize emails at scale, warm up and manage mailboxes, run multi-step campaigns, and turn replies into meetings and revenue. It provides lead enrichment from millions of contacts, intelligent warmups for better deliverability, inbox placement insights, a unified Onebox for reply management, real-time analytics, and done-for-you email accounts. Works with Gmail, Outlook, and any IMAP/SMTP provider, with APIs, webhooks, and integrations to tools like Zapier, Make, and Slack.

events.d: Creates a new campaign in your account.
Add one or more email addresses as leads to a selected campaign.
Remove an email from a selected campaign by choosing the campaign and entering the lead's email.
Add a lead to a chosen campaign using email and optional personalization fields.
Update a lead's status in a chosen campaign by selecting a lead or providing its email.
Remove leads from a campaign by ID(s), email, or all (with exclusions). Supports status, contains & leadStatus.
Update a lead in a selected campaign by ID or email, modifying first/last name, custom variables, or lead status.
Retrieve analytics for a chosen campaign between start and end dates; filter results and include/exclude subsequences.
Retrieve warmup performance metrics, optionally for a specific email account (ecId).
Start a campaign by entering its ID to begin sending outreach.
Pause a campaign by specifying its campaign ID.
Updates the selected campaign's name by choosing a campaign and entering a new name.
Retrieve campaigns with optional search, tag, archive filters, pagination, and selectable fields.
Retrieve current status for a selected campaign.
Update a campaign's settings like daily limits, tracking, lead rules, CC/BCC, and delivery options.
Pause or resume selected leads in a campaign by ID, email, filters, or exclusions.
Add a lead to a selected lead list using email, names, optional fields, and custom variables.
Remove leads from a selected lead list by ID, email, or remove all with optional excluded IDs.

Remove emails, domains, or keywords from the blocklist by ID or exact-value search.
Retrieve entries from a selected blocklist type; set optional search query, limit, and offset.
Add one or more email sequences to a selected campaign by providing sequences in JSON.
Runs when a new ReachInbox event occurs.
Retrieve leads from a selected campaign; select fields and paginate using last lead ID.
